intent: Pin and independently verify the integrated v1.4 calibration proposal, exact-request reuse and frozen execution manifest before judge calls.
verified_integrity: Reassembled the proposal independently and compared every fixture with the frozen snapshot.
Verified all 81 referenced prior file hashes and preserved their exact expected labels, metric, learner input and target output against the original clarified calibration records.

Verified all 10 added contrasts against the independently authored and parent-reviewed families, including context, history, learner contribution, inventory, target wording, declared action and expected pass/fail. The additions remain five proposed passes and five proposed failures.

The only replacement key is instruction_realization. Its full text exactly matches the independently audited v1.4 candidate file; current uses installed v1.3, and all other metric rubrics remain identical across conditions.
Recomputed the complete snapshot fingerprint after excluding only the fingerprint, command and start-time wrapper fields. It matches the supplied pin.
Verified frozen runner source, runner/evaluator/manifest dependencies and proposal hash against current bytes.
Reconstructed all 182 judge requests from each fixture, condition rubric and frozen settings; every request and SHA256 matches its job entry.
Each prior-request reuse matches its full provider request and endpoint. Cache population and aliases do not filter by agreement, grade or semantic outcome.
Expected labels and fixture identifiers remain evaluator bookkeeping. Judge requests carry the allowed evidence and declared target output rather than expected realization labels.
Resume validates fingerprint, condition, index, endpoint, request and fixture identity, and regrades preserved raw answers rather than regenerating an unfavorable verdict.
Actual returned request and endpoint are checked before saving a new answer. Missing, malformed and transport-error judgments cannot agree with a negative expected label merely because they failed.

verification.additional_read_only_assertions: Verified source/label/input/output reconstruction, paired-contrast fidelity, replacement equality, source/dependency pins, complete snapshot fingerprint and every frozen request/reuse identity.

execution_interpretation: 58 is the number of new unique judge requests, not a promise of 58 network attempts: the frozen transport policy permits up to three attempts for transient transport failures. Semantic failures are retained.

The settings file contains inherited target/repetition/concurrency descriptions; this calibration's executable coverage is 91 fixtures per condition and 16 workers, as frozen explicitly. Shared exact requests are dependent evidence, not repeated independent judgments.

The proposed rubric remains uninstalled and target scores remain unchanged. Full prior calibration plus new contrasts is required; any disagreement or evaluator error remains evidence and prevents declaring this condition fully calibrated.
A future adoption requires separate reviewed manifest/version changes and symmetric judging of preserved baseline/candidate outputs. This audit authorizes the pinned calibration condition only.
